title: Muranda waAllah Akakwidziridzwa
intro: Unonzwa makuhwa emunhu wekare, muranda waAllah akakwidziridzwa panzvimbo yepamusoro pevamwe. Munhu uyu aizivikanwa nemoyo murefu usingazununguki uye kutaura chokwadi chose, uye akatumwa kuvanhu vakaramba shoko. Mweya uyu wakakwidziridzwa ndiani?
clues: Ndakasarudzwa naAllah semuporofita uye ndinotaurwa muQuran Tsvene.
Ndaizivikanwa nemwoyo murefu wangu uye kutaura chokwadi, hunhu hunorumbidzwa naAllah.
Ndakadana vanhu vangu kuti vanamate Mwari mumwe chete, asi vazhinji vakandiramba.
Nzvimbo yangu yakasimudzirwa naAllah, uye ndakapihwa chinzvimbo chepamusoro.
Ndinowanzotaurwa pamwe chete nevamwe vaprofita vakaita saIsmail naDhul-Kifl.
Allah anoti nezvangu: 'Uye takamusimudzira panzvimbo yakakwirira.' (19:57)
verse: And We raised him to a high station. (19:57)
